question: How much of the rejected v0.34 ruler failure is local non-monotonicity versus missing robust endpoint support?
estimand: Exact L-infinity distance from each observed score curve to the cone of nonincreasing sequences.

decision_rule.ruler_admissible: Every required curve has a robust zero crossing at its exact repair radius.
decision_rule.ruler_not_admissible: At least one required curve lacks a robust zero crossing at its exact repair radius.

allowed_use: Design the next burned measurement pilot.
